Option (a): + and ÷

120 + 10 - 40

130 - 40

90 = 90

LHS is equal to RHS.

Thus, option (a) is correct.

16 - 200

-184 ≠ 90

LHS is not equal to RHS.

6 - 10 X 5 + 40

6 - 50 + 40

-4 ≠ 90

LHS is not equal to RHS.

Thus, option (d) is incorrect.
